name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2180: This is the answer to why is it asking me to relaunch and not updating automatically. drift_may_relaunch read the environment variable TV_AUTO_RELAUNCH and refused unless it was exactly 1, and the only thing in the whole system that exports that variable is tvd_supervisor.sh line 54. His live console runs with parent process 1 and the open flag, so it was not started by the supervisor, so the variable was simply absent, so auto-relaunch had been announcing only the entire time no matter what any ship did. Measured on his machine while writing this: the status route reports running v2162, disk v2179, drift true, with the feature armed since v2153. Two halves each built correctly and joined only if one happened to be the parent of the other, which is silent by construction. It is a persisted setting now, defaulting to on because that is what he asked for in as many words, with the environment variable kept as an explicit override in both directions so a terminal run can still force it either way. A saved off is still honoured, because a default may fill an unanswered question but must never overrule an answered one. The second half is the supervisor itself. tvd-scan.sh pauses it with a flag and tells the operator to run tvd-console.sh afterwards, and that step is easy to skip and nothing notices. Found on his machine with the flag dated August 3, which means the supervisor had stood down for twenty four days without a word. The pause now expires at a six hour ceiling and the stand down is logged with the age of the flag, because a supervisor that is not supervising and does not say so is indistinguishable from one that is.
